version.changelog:
Shelter skill initial release

- Connect to your Shelter financial data for real-time insights and coaching.
- Check safe-to-spend, predict cash crunches, and simulate affordability.
- Discover zombie subscriptions and saving opportunities.
- Get AI-powered financial coaching and ask complex questions to Guardian AI.
- Read-only access to bank data via Plaid; secure and privacy-focused.

llm.summary: The skill's requests, runtime instructions, and install scripts are consistent with a read-only financial agent that calls a Shelter API using a single API key; only minor documentation inconsistencies were found.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name, README, SKILL.md, and code all describe a read-only financial coaching integration that calls Shelter endpoints using an API key; requiring curl and SHELTER_API_KEY is proportionate. Minor inconsistency: documentation and metadata reference multiple domains (shelter.money, shelterfinance.com, api.shelterfinance.com) which should be clarified but doesn't contradict purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to call Shelter HTTP endpoints via curl with only the X-Shelter-Key header and an (optional) base URL. The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated files, other credentials, or system secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no remote download or binary installation. The included install/uninstall Node scripts copy SKILL.md and the references directory into the user's ~/.claude/skills (or project .claude path). This is expected behavior for an instruction-only skill but will write files into the user's home directory; nothing else is installed or executed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one required environment variable is declared (SHELTER_API_KEY), which matches the runtime curl examples. SKILL.md references an optional SHELTER_API_URL (with a sensible default) but does not declare it as required — this is acceptable but worth noting. No unrelated credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-included and does not request elevated or persistent platform privileges. Install scripts only write skill files to a per-user skill directory; they do not modify other skills or system-wide agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it says: a read-only Shelter integration that uses a single API key to call Shelter endpoints. Before installing: (1) Confirm you obtained your SHELTER_API_KEY from the official Shelter site (note the README/metadata reference shelter.money and shelterfinance.com — verify which domain is authoritative). (2) Ensure the API key you create is scoped to read-only / agent access only (do not use highly privileged or general-purpose cloud credentials). (3) Be aware the installer will copy SKILL.md and the references folder into ~/.claude/skills (or a project-level .claude path) — check those files if you want to review them locally. (4) If you plan to allow autonomous agent invocation, remember the agent will be able to call the Shelter API using your key; revoke the key immediately if you suspect misuse. Lastly, if you want extra assurance, verify the upstream repository (package.json points to github.com/nextauralabs/shelter-skill) and the publisher identity before installing.
